projects.title: Zeba Fashion: Modern Direct-to-Consumer E-Commerce Storefront
projects.tagline: High-performance online fashion storefront with razor-sharp checkout, mobile-first product filtering, and payment gateway integration.
projects.challenge: Launching a high-growth fashion label online required a fast, glitch-free shopping platform capable of handling flash sales and instant mobile checkout without sluggish page reloads.
projects.solution: Built a headless e-commerce web application featuring reactive product filtering, instant cart calculations, secure Razorpay checkout integration, and automated order notifications.
projects.architecture: React and Tailwind CSS frontend, Node.js API services, PostgreSQL product catalog database, Razorpay payment webhooks, and Vercel edge deployment.
deliverables: Responsive direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront with instant mobile navigation
Interactive product catalog with color, size, and category filtering
Integrated payment gateway with UPI, Card, and Netbanking support
Automated WhatsApp & Email order receipt dispatch pipeline

testimonial.quote: The speed and look of our store exceeded our expectations. The checkout is seamless, and our mobile shoppers love the smooth browsing experience.
